_comment: Batch 005-R -- the targeted revision the owner required.
LOCKED and CONFIRMED did not separate at 39.6 m. The fix is one cue on
the head itself, not on the floor ring: the cage's NEGATIVE SPACE.
Locked leaves it open, confirmed fills it -- the husk slumps across
the cradle and a shutter descends the uprights onto it.
Only the five sheets the verdict asked for. Nothing else changed, so
nothing else is re-shot here; the full batch005 set is re-rendered in
place because the confirmed mesh moved.
